description:
Make `jit issue create` render the findings creation returns through one renderer, the same set in human and JSON output.

## Background

- Creation returns `findings` (wire `ReportedFinding`), local-rule findings first and then graph-rule findings, derived inside its mutation. The `IssueCommands::Create` arm of `crates/jit/src/main.rs` (`:1841-1869`) makes no read after the mutation publishes, and `--json` returns `IssueCreateResponse` with those `findings`, registered in the schema for `issue create`.
- The human path still renders the two halves differently: local findings through `eprintln!("Warning: [rule] message")` (`:1842-1844`), which also runs under `--quiet` and in `--json` mode, and graph findings through `OutputContext::print_warning` (`:1866-1868`), which `--quiet` silences. `IssueCreation::split_findings` exists only to feed the two paths.
- Create-time warning coverage lives in the workflow-package tests of `crates/jit/src/profile/repository_package.rs` (`create_time_warnings` and its tests), which evaluate the package's hierarchy rules over one issue through `evaluate_graph`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `issue create --json` returns an `IssueCreateResponse` that flattens the issue view and adds `findings`, registered in the schema for `issue create`, and in `--json` mode no human finding line reaches stdout or stderr. The human path prints one line per finding through one renderer, in one format. Both show the same findings; `--force` suppresses none; `--quiet` prints only the id.
- [hard] REQ-02: After creation publishes, the arm makes no storage, executor or capture call: no issue list, no graph-rule evaluation, no dependency enrichment and no gate-run listing.
- [hard] REQ-03: A CLI test creates an orphan leaf with `--json` and finds its `orphan-leaf` finding in `findings`, and with the human path finds the same finding.
- [hard] REQ-04: The workflow-package create-time warning tests in `profile/repository_package.rs` pass unchanged.

## Notes

- Behaviour change: local-rule and graph-rule findings print together in one format, and `--json` output carries findings only in its response.
- Steward amendment 2026-11-04: criteria trimmed after the creation-findings task delivered the response type and the no-read arm, and removed `--orphan`.
title: Issue creation output shows its findings, with no read after the mutation commits
